the pressure and solar cooking methods are useful in the reduction of antinutrients in cowpeas, but solar cooking is more effective in reducing polyphenols and phytic acid.

soaking, followed by pressure or solar cooking, can reduce the phytic acid content by 40–80 per cent, and the polyphenol content by 60–95 per cent, in cowpea seeds.
